mainEntity.name: How does AI Website Optimization differ from traditional SEO?

acceptedAnswer.text: While traditional SEO focuses on keywords, backlinks, and technical elements to rank in organic search results, AI Website Optimization for AEO emphasizes understanding user intent and providing direct, concise answers. AEO prepares your site for AI-driven search by optimizing for semantic relevance, structured data, and conversational queries, which are crucial for appearing in featured snippets and direct answer boxes. Traditional SEO still matters, but AEO goes further by ensuring your content is AI-consumable, anticipating how AI will interpret and present information to users.
acceptedAnswer.description: Traditional SEO focuses on keywords and rankings, while AI Website Optimization for AEO optimizes for semantic understanding, direct answers, and AI-driven search engines.
